title: How Telegram launched Sponsored Messages: ads without user data
summary: Durov announces Telegram's first ad product, built around privacy: no ads in chats, no user-data targeting, only topic-based placement in large public channels. The post shows how to monetize a free platform to cover costs while sharing revenue with creators and positioning against WhatsApp.

principles.text: Monetize without mining user data: target ads only by channel topic, never by private user data.
principles.quote: User data will not be used to target ads. As with everything we do, our main priority is protecting the private data of our users.
